system.description: You can siphon off some of a creatures physical stamina as part of your assault. When you deal Chakra damage to a creature, you can spend 1 Superiority Die to steal their physical stamina. The target must make a Wisdom Saving throw vs the attack types DC (If Weapon/Unarmed, Taijutsu save DC). On a failed save the target gains 1 rank of Slow. If the target of this maneuvers attack has ranks of any Mental condition, they make their save at disadvantage.
